prompt_en: Photorealistic 4:5 environmental fashion editorial, framed as a natural eye-level three-quarter figure. Feature one unmistakably adult woman, about 30, in a decommissioned coastal cable-car terminal built into a sea cliff after rain. Image 1 supplies general visible appearance guidance for a new original adult model: long dark center-parted wavy hair, softly defined brows, brown eyes, and restrained natural makeup; her facial identity remains original to this scene. She plants one boot on the grated platform and pulls a waist-high red brake lever with both hands as an empty gondola rolls past the open portal; posture, hand contact, lever angle, and cabin motion make the action immediately legible. She wears a revealing editorial outfit with opaque fabric covering her breasts and pelvis. Over that stable base, the sheer garment uses a translucent organza layer that remains visibly present as a textile; its visible weave seam and edge plus folded borders remain sharply legible. Coherent amber light passes through the fabric in one direction. The sheer overlay above an opaque base leaves the solid breast and pelvis panels fully covered. Overlapping folds become denser and less transparent while single layers transmit more light. The dry organza alone carries translucency; skin, solid panels, machinery, and air retain normal opacity and crisp detail. Salt mist, wet steel, layered pulleys, and the storm-dark ocean create deep coastal scale while controlled highlights preserve textile boundaries.
